title: FFCropEvaporation
description: A mod that makes crops require water, and has a chance to replace nearby water with a block when growing. A Fyxe's Features mod.
body:
This is part of my ongoing "survival"-type mods. If you like this, check out [FFNutrition](https://modrinth.com/mod/ffnutrition)!

# <center>TL;DR:</center>
- Crops have a chance to replace nearby water with a block when growing
- Crops no longer grow without water
- Entirely configurable
- Only effects crops that grow on farmland

# <center>Description</center>
The idea behind this mod was to make farming and water more engaging mechanics. Having to tend to your fields can feel rewarding, as well as finding ways to automate it! 

The mod is also configurable! The blocks that crops replace are a weighted table that you can modify. You can also enable and disable replacing of non-source blocks as well as completely turn off the requirement for water to grow! 

Works best when paired with mods, such as:
- [Finite Water](https://modrinth.com/mod/toffelsfinitewater)
- [Simple Water Gravity](https://modrinth.com/mod/simple-water-gravity)
- [Flowing Fluids](https://modrinth.com/mod/flowing-fluids) 

# What is FF?
Fyxe's Features are small mods that are designed to be easily added (or removed) from any modpack. They often revolve around adding a few items or creating compatibility between mods in simple, non-intrusive ways.
